The '''Stobar Spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stobar/Legends|Stobar]]. The [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[Plop Dribble's/Legends|Plop Dribble's]] was located in this spaceport, owned by [[Loubo/Legends|Loubo]].
